short_description: Feature-rich Intel Z790 ATX motherboard with DDR5, PCIe 5.0, Wi-Fi 6E, 4× M.2 & strong power delivery.
key_features: DDR5 up to 7200+ MHz OC, PCIe 5.0 x16, 4× M.2, Wi-Fi 6E, 2.5G LAN, premium VRM.
long_description: The MSI MAG Z790 TOMAHAWK WIFI is designed for high-performance builds with Intel LGA1700 CPUs. It offers cutting-edge features like PCIe 5.0 for next-gen GPUs, robust power stages (16 + 1 + 1), extensive storage slots (4× M.2 & 7× SATA), ultra-fast networking (Wi-Fi 6E & 2.5G LAN), and advanced memory support (DDR5 up to 7200+ MHz OC). The board also includes multiple USB-C/Type-A ports including 20 Gbps support and user-friendly firmware with BIOS Flashback for easy updates.

pci_express_slots: 1× PCIe 4.0 x16 (SafeSlot) + additional PCIe 4.0 x16/x1 slots
short_description: Mid-range AM5 ATX gaming motherboard with DDR5, PCIe 5.0 on M.2, Wi-Fi 6E, and robust power delivery.
key_features: AM5 support, DDR5 up to 6400+ MHz, PCIe 5.0 M.2, Wi-Fi 6E, 2.5G LAN, SupremeFX audio
long_description: The ASUS ROG STRIX B650-A GAMING WIFI is an AMD AM5-based ATX motherboard designed for Ryzen™ 7000 Series processors, offering a balanced feature set for gaming and productivity. It supports DDR5 memory up to 128 GB with OC profiles, next-gen storage with one PCIe 5.0 M.2 slot plus two PCIe 4.0 M.2 slots, and networking with Wi-Fi 6E + 2.5G Ethernet. The board’s robust 12+2+1 power stages and quality cooling help sustain performance under load, while USB-C Gen 2x2 and multiple high-speed ports ensure versatile connectivity. Aura Sync RGB and ASUS utilities further enhance the user experience.

short_description: Micro-ATX Intel B760 board with DDR4, Wi-Fi 6E, 2× M.2, 2.5Gb LAN.
key_features: Wi-Fi 6E, 2× M.2 PCIe 4.0 slots, 2.5GbE LAN, 4× DDR4 slots, Q-Flash Plus.
long_description: The GIGABYTE B760M DS3H AX DDR4 is a budget-friendly micro-ATX motherboard for Intel LGA1700 platforms featuring DDR4 memory support up to 5333 MHz (OC), dual M.2 PCIe 4.0 storage, robust 6+2+1 phase VRM, integrated Wi-Fi 6E and Bluetooth, and 2.5 GbE LAN. It offers versatile connectivity with USB Type-C Gen2, multiple USB 3.2/USB 2.0 ports, and integrated graphics outputs for lightweight gaming and productivity systems. Q-Flash Plus lets you update BIOS without CPU/RAM installed, and the board supports Intel 12th/13th/14th Gen CPUs with efficient power delivery in a compact mATX layout.

short_description: Micro-ATX AMD B650 motherboard with DDR5, PCIe 4.0, dual M.2 & Wi-Fi 6E.
key_features: Micro-ATX AMD B650 motherboard with DDR5, PCIe 4.0, dual M.2 & Wi-Fi 6E.
long_description: The MSI B650M GAMING WIFI is a compact AM5 micro-ATX motherboard built around the AMD B650 chipset, designed for modern Ryzen gaming systems with DDR5 memory support up to 7800+ MHz OC, dual PCIe Gen4 M.2 SSD slots, and solid networking including Wi-Fi 6E and Bluetooth 5.3. It provides a PCIe 4.0 x16 slot for discrete GPUs, 4 SATA ports, and robust audio (Realtek) for immersive gaming. The board also features MSI’s Core Boost power design to ensure stable performance under load, making it a great value-oriented choice for mainstream AMD builds.

short_description: ATX Intel Z790 motherboard with DDR5, PCIe 5.0, 4× M.2, Wi-Fi 6E & 2.5Gb LAN.

long_description: The ASUS TUF GAMING Z790-PLUS WIFI is a robust ATX motherboard built for Intel LGA 1700 platforms, offering a strong 16+1 DrMOS power design, extensive storage with four M.2 slots and four SATA ports, high-speed DDR5 memory support with OC potential, and premium connectivity including Wi-Fi 6E, Bluetooth, 2.5Gb LAN and multiple high-speed USB-C ports. Its PCIe 5.0 x16 slot ensures readiness for next-gen GPUs while advanced cooling, ASUS TUF protections and Aura Sync RGB support round out a gaming-focused but versatile build foundation.
